title: fix(host-config): `host.runner` should not apply to `cargo run`

target.summary: When cross-compiling with `-Zhost-config`, an explicit host runner is inserted even though the host target was not requested. Calling `target_runner` for the unrequested host target causes Cargo to panic because its target configuration was not initialized in `target_data`.
notes: faulty condition inserting explicit host runner without checking if host target was requested
